meta.name: how-it-works
meta.description: Explain how claude-mem captures observations, when memory injection kicks in, and where data lives. Use when the user asks "how does claude-mem work?" or "what is this thing doing?".

copy.tagline: 解释 claude-mem 的工作原理与数据存储方式
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果用户常问 claude-mem 如何工作或数据存哪里
copy.tagline_en: Explain how claude-mem works and where data is stored
copy.fit_line_en: For you if users often ask how claude-mem works or where data lives

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会按技能说明解释 claude-mem：每次读取、编辑或运行命令都会压缩成一条观察，会话结束时汇总，相关记忆自动注入后续对话；数据存在本机 ~/.claude-mem，除压缩用的 AI 服务外不离开本机。
howto.when: 当用户问“claude-mem 是怎么工作的？”或“它到底在做什么？”时触发。

say.note: 按记录、汇总、注入三部分解释。

say.text: claude-mem 的数据都存在哪里？
say.note: 说明存在 ~/.claude-mem，并提到隐私边界。

say.text: 记忆什么时候会注入到对话里？

howto.what_en: When asked, Claude explains claude-mem: each Read/Edit/Bash becomes a compressed observation, summarized at session end; relevant ones auto-inject into future prompts. Data stays in ~/.claude-mem and only compression calls reach the chosen provider.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user asks “how does claude-mem work?” or “what is this thing doing?”.

say_en.note: Claude explains the capture, summary, and injection flow.
Claude points to ~/.claude-mem and explains the privacy boundary.
Claude says it starts on the second session and /learn-codebase can preload.
